title: Birth-weight paradox
content: Smoking and birth defects both lower birth weight, making birth weight a collider. Restricting analysis to low-birth-weight babies opens a noncausal path from smoking through birth defect to infant mortality.

variables.name: Birth Weight
variables.content: The child's birth weight and the collider in Figure 5.4.

variables.name: Birth Defect
variables.content: Serious congenital causes that can lower birth weight and increase mortality.

variables.name: Mortality of Child
variables.content: Infant mortality, the outcome in the paradox.
